blocks.text: NEW YORK — Call her a Raye of sunshine. The English singer-songwriter leads the 2027 Grammy Award nominations, the Recording Academy announced Monday, Nov. 16. Raye is up for 11 awards at February’s ceremony: record, song and album of the year — the first time she’s been nominated in those big categories — as well as songwriter of the year non-classical, a variety of pop categories and music video. Her 11 nods also mean she has tied Beyoncé’s record at the 2025 Grammys for the most nominations in a single year by a female artist.
